name: Pipeliners - GA4 Comparison Jun vs Sep 2026
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-24

# Summary
GA4 comparison for the Pipeliners USA Website property (406463023, account "ON + Pipeliners") using the built-in Organic traffic comparison. Like-for-like window: Sep 1 to 21 vs Jun 1 to 21, 2026. Built from PDF exports Kim made (ga4-01 to ga4-10).

# Key findings
- Organic traffic segment: sessions 102 to 97 (-4.9%), active users 74 to 65, new users 68 to 51 (-25%), engagement time 52s to 1m 00s, key events 0 in both.
- Organic Search only: sessions 99 to 96, engaged sessions 48 to 53, engagement rate 48.48% to 55.21%.
- All channels: sessions 1,283 to 1,328; engaged sessions 400 to 524; key events 9 to 4. Direct +72%, Cross-network -50%, Display +34%, Paid Search +14%. Organic Search is about 7% of sessions.
- Organic landing pages: home 64 to 51, reline-vs-replace 13 to 5; new organic landing pages /gilbert and several blog posts.
- generate_lead: 31 events from 25 users Jun 1 to Sep 23, about 2 a week (0 to 5). It matches key event totals, so it is effectively the site's key event. Lead tracking did not stop; the 9 to 4 fall is within weekly noise.
- Full June organic baseline: 161 sessions, 115 users, 0 key events.

# Decisions and status
- ga4-04 and ga4-05 used unequal dates and were not used.
- Optional: confirm in Admin that generate_lead is the only key event.
